body:
A distinct private FP32 quotient-estimate candidate has passed source arithmetic review, policy/assembly recovery and the complete normal Endpoint structural graph. Numerical execution and cost remain unqualified; the rejected FP64 candidate remains rejected.

The candidate keeps the original finite classification, unpack/normalization, rounding and full radix-8/8/8/2 fallback. It treats one native binary32 division as an untrusted proposal, checks its positive binade, verifies the exact two-word residual of a guarded integer guess, and accepts only a residual below 32 times the normalized divisor. One exact uint32 corrective division then reconstructs the original quotient/sticky result. No native division accuracy or hit-rate premise is used. The candidate shader requires Shader/Float32/Int32 only; the canonical default header remains unchanged.

The [first compiler owner](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/blob/f5758f98ee1596cf3dc266a071fcd53e4d2181de/attestations/software-vulkan/4bcd987/fp32-estimate-compiler-policy-stop/result.json) remains **false/child-exit 1**: compilation and the original SSA pass completed, but the private policy correctly refused the undecorated proposal FDiv32. No compiler retry followed. A [separate policy finisher](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/blob/4ad679a141d1279791faa170859ce7f2abbae537/attestations/software-vulkan/4bcd987/fp32-estimate-policy-recovery/result.json) added exactly the proposal NoContraction decoration and the original two RTE declaration lines to a fresh assembly view, then passed the unchanged scoped policy, assembly and Vulkan 1.2 validation. Its 152,844-byte final SPV is SHA256 `0535c0f6a689d2d59896543882e1f5300fdd67fe70509b7dda0996f59ffd03d9`. All 10,339 assembler/readback instructions match under ID renaming. NoContraction does not supply an accuracy claim.

The [actual graph run and independent audit](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/blob/23619ee8a99ac792d6d76dbeb376356c4168dbc2/attestations/software-vulkan/4bcd987/fp32-estimate-graph-review/result.json) passed in 4.105 seconds, bound to 708 rich static pins and 711 before/after/current consumed rows. All three positive, 38 graph rejection and two helper rejection controls passed. The reader covers the complete original prefix/fallback, exact new-region instruction coverage, closed phi edges, guard dominance and common sign/exponent/round joins. All 23 non-Divide helper bodies match, including both same-named WideShiftJam instances. Source review corrected missing exact-import/duplicate-helper handling and strengthened exponent/NoWrap/extra-instruction checks before any reader run; the held earlier draft was never executed. Mutation controls are full-module text checks, not assembled or numerically executed mutants.

All three immutable archives are committed, pushed and byte verified. Their completed scratch roots were removed after exact archive inventories and fresh recorded-birth absence checks. Canonical 4498cc41168ad29fc4c111819a4cb7ccaa54a8bf remains clean, committed and pushed on development/minimum-step-floor-2026-10-15 with one worktree.

Next is the ordinary driver/JIT cost screen, using the exact reusable canonical host and original LLVM pipelines. It must account for the retained corrective division, fallback/mixed lanes, native code, stack and coroutine frame. The short canary returns before arithmetic. Original arithmetic, full integrated controls, all unchanged 20+2 benefit gates, cold-frame/UI/hardware/science/platform/release acceptance remain open; no adoption or qualification is claimed.
